Hamzat is the Arabic plural form حَمْزَات (Ḥamzāt) of حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), used as a personal name in West African and South Asian Muslim communities. The source gloss 'protector, defender' is unsupported; the underlying name's traditional association is with the lion.
